# mcp.build

> Hosted, open-source MCP servers for AI agents.

Homepage: https://mcp.build
Repository: https://github.com/hal9ai/mcp.build
Catalog: https://mcp.build/agents.json

## Agents

mcp.build is a catalog of already-deployed MCP servers. Every server in the catalog:
- Is live and reachable via a single HTTPS endpoint
- Accepts natural-language prompts and translates them to the right tool calls
- Is fully open source — inspect the code, self-host it, or contribute your own
- Shares the same contract and setup flow, so adding a second MCP takes seconds

Target audience: AI agent builders (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Grok Build, custom LLM agents) who want to add real-world capabilities without writing or hosting any infrastructure.

## Audience for contributions

Coding agents and developers who want to publish an MCP. Prefer small PRs that add one agent folder and its deploy workflow. See AGENTS.md for the full contract.

## Website structure

- Homepage (`https://mcp.build/`) — catalog of available MCPs with copy-and-connect endpoints
- Each MCP has a page at `https://mcp.build/<id>/` (e.g. `https://mcp.build/send-email/`)
- Installing MCPs guide: `https://mcp.build/installing-mcps/`
- Machine-readable catalog: `https://mcp.build/agents.json`

## Agent contract

Every agent is a top-level directory with:
- `app.py` — read user text via `input()`, write result via `print()`
- `requirements.txt` — optional Python deps
- `hal9.yaml` — optional (`welcome:` message)

Deploy when the folder changes via `.github/workflows/<name>.yaml`.

## Existing agents

- **send-email** — `https://mcp.build/send-email/`
  - Endpoint: `https://next.hal9.ai/mcp/mcpbuild/send-email`
  - Example: `send email to javier@hal9.ai with text hello!`
  - Built with: Groq (tool use) + Resend (email delivery)

- **run-python** — `https://mcp.build/run-python/`
  - Endpoint: `https://next.hal9.ai/mcp/mcpbuild/run-python`
  - Example: `install a package that calculates space orbits and compute the Hohmann transfer time from Earth to Mars and back, departing 2026-09-08`
  - Built with: Groq (tool use) + sandboxed Python + pip install

- **search-web** — https://mcp.build/search-web/
  - Endpoint: https://next.hal9.ai/mcp/mcpbuild/search-web
  
- **fetch-url** — https://mcp.build/fetch-url/
  - Endpoint: https://next.hal9.ai/mcp/mcpbuild/fetch-url

## Do not

- Add heavy app frameworks (Flask/FastAPI) for simple tool agents
- Put multiple unrelated tools in one folder
- Change unrelated agents in the same PR unless required
- Commit `.env`, keys, or `__pycache__`
